Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At “又香又好看,” add a concrete visual detail about the plant: “黄色的花像星星一样，又大又漂亮。”
2. After Shennong sees the plant, add his thought to show his hope: “神农心想：这可能就是能做药的植物。”
3. Add a feeling during the long journey to make the effort more vivid: “他走了三个月，觉得又累又渴，但是没有放弃。”

ideas.reason: It adds a simple, concrete description that fits the plant.
It gives Shennong a natural thought that fits his search for medicinal plants.
It adds believable effort and determination during the three-month journey.
